title: Winged Blue Devil on Lake
description: A blue-skinned devil with large golden and blue feathered wings stands on a broken stone platform in the center of a reflective lake. He wears a beige trench coat over a vest and dark pants, with a glowing halo above his head, set against a surreal purple sky with a giant glowing orb and ancient stone arches.
prompt: A blue-skinned humanoid devil with massive blue and golden feathered wings stands confidently on a cracked stone platform in the middle of a calm reflective lake. He wears an open beige trench coat, vest, and dark pants, with a glowing pink halo above his head. Ancient stone arches and ruins rise from the water on both sides, connected by thin wires. The dramatic purple and pink swirling sky contains a large glowing orb with a black center and floating butterflies, petals, and golden symbols. Epic fantasy style, highly detailed, cinematic lighting.
